card.name: Inside literature citation titles
card.fires_on: Small words, punctuation and digits inside journal reference entries, such as DOI strings, volume numbers and article titles in reference lists.

modes.label: DOI digits and dots
modes.description: Digits or periods inside a DOI string in a reference entry.

modes.label: Words inside article titles
modes.description: Linking words or nouns like of, by, sample in a cited paper title.
modes.example: Modulation of signaling nuclear factor-kappaB activation pathway<< by>> polyphenols in human intestinal Caco

modes.label: Citation separators
modes.description: Commas after volume or compound names in a reference.
